name: Charged Gauntlets
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Charged Gauntlets

effects.name: Shocking Blow
effects.tooltip: Shocking Blow : This item is charged with electricity. When in melee, on an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will punish the target with a large electric shock (10 to 60 electric damage). A successful Reflex save (DC 22) reduces this damage by half.

effects.name: Strength
effects.tooltip: Strength +4 : This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +4 Enhancement bonus to Strength.

effects.name: Electric Resistance
effects.tooltip: Electric Resistance +14 : Passive: +14 Enhancement bonus to your Electric Resistance.

effects.name: Might of the Abishai
effects.tooltip: Might of the Abishai : 3 Piece Equipped: +3 Profane bonus to Natural Armor +1 Profane bonus to all Ability Scores +1 Profane bonus to DCs 5 Piece Equipped: +5 Profane bonus to Natural Armor +2 Profane bonus to all Ability Scores +2 Profane bonus to DCs

flavor_text: These gloves channel powerful electric energy into enemies that you strike.
